UPPSC Staff Nurse Result 2026 - Complete Details

UPPSC Staff Nurse Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now check their result and download the scorecard from the official website. The last date to apply is 03/07/2025. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 03/06/2025
  • Last Date : 03/07/2025
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 03/07/2025
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 17/03/2026
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 03/06/2025
  • Last Date : 03/07/2025
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 03/07/2025
  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 125/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 65/-
  • Post Name : Total Post
  • Staff Nurse : 03 Post

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
